newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh's ICB offers more credit to investors.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh's ICB offers more credit to investors.

text.p: The state-owned Investment Corporation of Bangladesh has increased the amount of stocks investors can buy on margin, an ICB statement said.
"The people who maintain investment accounts with ICB will be able to enjoy the facility in case of purchasing stocks in primary and secondary markets," the statement said.
Brokerage ICB, which is also the country's only institutional investor, said investors would now be able to buy two shares on margin for every one share purchased.
